relations.subject: Kashinath Trimbak Telang
relations.evidence: entered the high school in Bombay which bears the name of Mountstuart Elphinstone. Here he came under the influence of Narayan Mahadev Purmanand, a teacher of intellect and force of character

relations.subject: Kashinath Trimbak Telang
relations.evidence: From this school he passed to the Elphinstone College, of which he became a fellow, and after taking the degree of M.A. and LL.B.

relations.subject: Kashinath Trimbak Telang
relations.evidence: From this school he passed to the Elphinstone College, of which he became a fellow

relations.subject: Kashinath Trimbak Telang
relations.evidence: the University of Bombay, over which he presided as vice-chancellor for two years (1892-1893) until his death.

relations.subject: Kashinath Trimbak Telang
relations.evidence: He was syndic of the university from 1881, and vice-chancellor from 1892 until his death.

relations.subject: Kashinath Trimbak Telang
relations.object: Bombay Branch of the Royal Asiatic Society
relations.evidence: In that year also he was elected President of the Bombay Branch of the Royal Asiatic Society.
